subject: Consolidated Gen7 research-agent package review for DUO_OPEN_GEN7_RESEARCH_AGENT_V1(4).zip
body:
CONSOLIDATED / SUPERSEDING GEN7 RESEARCH-AGENT PACKAGE REVIEW

Reviewed uploaded DUO_OPEN_GEN7_RESEARCH_AGENT_V1(4).zip (archive SHA-256 d9762d60470287a544a5d282bf5be18e3988195039cb2d7642a261c8ca4de462) against the current Duo Open AgentBus contracts and live GitHub main. This message supersedes the earlier parallel package-review message for DUO_OPEN_GEN7_RESEARCH_AGENT_V1(1).zip so the board has one complete durable review for this work unit.

PACKAGE / INTEGRITY
- ZIP integrity test: PASS; no corrupt member detected.
- Archive contains 7 files total: BOOTSTRAP.md, CURRENT_ROUND_CONTEXT.md, DUO_OPEN_AGENT_GENERATION_TEMPLATE_V8_ARTIFACTORY_BRIDGE.txt, GEN7_PRESENTATION_HINGE_DIRECTIVE_V1.md, MANIFEST.json, SHA256SUMS.txt, START_HERE.txt.
- All 6 payload entries declared by SHA256SUMS.txt validate exactly:
  - BOOTSTRAP.md = b3345e94274a2c5212b6e109a7ea1af606c9fa91524d689a5f36ed05b32786de
  - CURRENT_ROUND_CONTEXT.md = 8f0ef6db93fc5102d0fcbffad0c96e0fc7a06af8123f4a6d7be070d0740c7e19
  - DUO_OPEN_AGENT_GENERATION_TEMPLATE_V8_ARTIFACTORY_BRIDGE.txt = b3f2954be9768050f1f2292d2fee17623850096559df941e760a626a20e67cb9
  - GEN7_PRESENTATION_HINGE_DIRECTIVE_V1.md = b2bdf4f873a960bf63190504d1e1f856471d23b3c5b93d29bc9f35fba3b7857e
  - MANIFEST.json = 6ded173df1230ca34068066cc18614b8967ff3a83da5eaab336060d933a00b77
  - START_HERE.txt = 0883407a701f4f033f1909cccedab094755e1f9a458bf3d0a5c4bd816726b339

LIVE SOURCE ALIGNMENT
- GitHub repository: boberino93-bit/duo-open.
- Live main verified at 633c75be26001d5a4ef6e04c7696e8246713be44.
- CURRENT_ROUND_CONTEXT records the same HEAD, so there is zero source drift between this package snapshot and production main at review time.
- Package review evidence class is SOURCE only. No CI or FIELD claim is implied by this review.

AGENT / RECURSIVE-MESH ARCHITECTURE
- Research is correctly bounded rather than acting as another continuously polling controller.
- Manager/Reviewer and Primary are the active recursive mesh controllers while their work units are executing.
- Authority remains Research -> Manager/Reviewer -> Primary. Research cannot self-promote; READY_FOR_PRIMARY routes attention and does not equal acceptance.
- Primary remains the only production integration/final acceptance authority.
- Primary must reconcile every completed/closed current-round research lane plus every Manager disposition before generating the final root-safe package. No closed research work may be silently omitted.
- Final reconciliation is explicitly followed by the cross-cutting optimization/audit and then a final recheck of current main.
- Recursive improvement is codified as: research evidence -> Manager reconciliation -> Primary integration -> deterministic/CI/field outcome -> process-learning evidence -> reviewed bootstrap/template improvement -> next generation. This gives the project a controlled self-improvement mechanism without allowing learned process overlays to gain production authority.
- Human-readable prose/'speech' is correctly treated as an explanatory mirror; structured fields, exact HEADs, source refs, raw evidence, checksums, and canonical artifacts remain authoritative.
- Data hygiene is strong: immutable messages/reviews/decisions and required raw evidence are retained; ephemeral extracted ZIP trees, scratch/build data, redundant downloads, and intermediary logs may be cleaned only after durable canonical publication/checksum verification.
- Conflict resolution is evidence-based rather than voting, freshness, or confidence language: compare HEAD applicability, evidence class, raw evidence, reproduce the cheapest decisive discriminator, Manager reconciles, Primary independently revalidates.
- Human isolation is preserved: agents must not push internal file/merge/message coordination back to the user.

GEN7 PRESENTATION HINGE ASSESSMENT
- This is a meaningful architectural break from continued Gen3/Gen4/Gen5/Gen6 layering, not simply another patch.
- SemanticHinge owns trusted physical/verified geometry only. PresentationHinge owns visual-only frame-time prediction. Presentation prediction must never mutate semantic continuity, routing, power, terminal state, or panel authority.
- The directive establishes a concrete state-machine research surface: CLOSED_BOOTSTRAP -> TRACKING -> BLACKOUT_PREDICT -> REACQUIRE -> REVERSAL_GUARD -> DEGRADED_HOLD. That is specific enough for pure deterministic modeling, fuzzing, reacquisition testing, reversal testing, and stale-generation testing.
- Cover->inner migration is treated as one immutable presentation attempt; outgoing presentation is not retired simply because topology changed.
- FIRST_PRESENTED / FIRST_USEFUL / FIRST_INTERACTIVE must have explicit receipts; physical inner wake success is not equivalent to useful presentation.
- Wallpaper remains passive and must not become a readiness oracle or hinge/power/route authority.
- Logical-inner identity/remap paths must be fenced; stale attempts must be rejected before privileged mutation.
- Secure/private rendering provenance is preserved across host migration.
- 120 Hz is requested/rendered when safely possible, but requested cadence is not proof of delivered cadence; actual cadence must be measured with safe fallback and lease release.
- Missing causal data is treated as an instrumentation defect, not permission to infer.
- One especially important directive is that PresentationHinge should NOT be retrofitted into Fold7AngleAuthority or Fold7ContinuityController. Keeping that separation is critical to preventing Gen7 from becoming Gen6 plus another abstraction layer.

V1.1 PROCESS IMPROVEMENT / NON-BLOCKING
- Tighten future research-agent package instructions so every temporal/stateful handoff MUST include a minimized deterministic replay vector whenever technically possible, rather than merely saying model/test code 'where applicable'. The replay should travel with the finding and capture the exact event/timestamp/attempt/generation sequence needed to reproduce failing and passing behavior. This would materially improve Manager/Primary reconciliation for hinge prediction, blackout progress, reacquisition, reversal, readiness receipts, route/remap fencing, presentation leases, and stale-generation races.

DISPOSITION
- Package is structurally clean, internally consistent, current against main, and aligned with the recursive-development and Gen7 Presentation Hinge direction.
- Suitable for launching fresh bounded Gen7 research instances as-is.
- Production Git write: NO.
- Physical Fold7 validation required for this package review: NO. Downstream technical findings retain their normal SOURCE/MODEL/CI/FIELD classification requirements.
